tagline: A daily moisturizer designed to strengthen the skin barrier, replenish hydration, and leave skin soft, balanced and comfortable.
description: Designed for everyday use, CLIMATE ADAPT MOISTURIZER helps strengthen the skin barrier and replenish hydration, leaving skin feeling soft, balanced and comfortable. Its breathable gel-cream texture provides climate-adaptive hydration for a comfortable daily moisturizing experience.
image_alt: EMBRAE Climate Adapt Moisturizer, 50 g gel-cream moisturizer
benefits: Leaves skin soft, balanced and comfortable
routine_text: Add Reset, Defend and Protect to complete the routine.
essentials_heading: Climate Adapt Moisturizer, at a glance.

howto.title: Smooth
howto.text: Smooth evenly over face and neck.

howto.title: Massage
howto.text: Gently massage in upward circular motions until fully absorbed.

inci: Aqua, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Squalane, Dicaprylyl Carbonate, Saccharide Isomerate, Ceramide NP (and) Ceramide AP (and) Ceramide EOP (and) Sodium Lauroyl Lactylate, Beta-Sitosterol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Sodium Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Hydrogenated Polydecene, Trideceth-6, Sorbitan Laurate, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Hamamelis Virginiana (Witch Hazel) Extract, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Beta-Glucan, Linoleic Acid, Allantoin, Ectoin, Dimethyl Isosorbide, Acetyl Tetrapeptide-11, Acetyl Tetrapeptide-9, Tocopherol, Polysorbate 80, Phytosphingosine, Disodium EDTA.
storage:
Storage instructions
Store below 30°C in a cool, dry place. Protect from direct sunlight and excessive heat. Keep the cap closed when not in use.

Caution
Avoid contact with eyes. In case of contact, rinse thoroughly with water.

Note
Perform a patch test before use. Discontinue if irritation occurs.

For external use only.
